title: SepsisBridge: 3-site secure aggregation (pairwise masks) vs plain FedAvg

site_description.hospB: hospital B, the small hospital (10% subset, training part)
site_description.left_out: 7612 hospital A patients with unknown ICU unit

simulation_note: hospA1 and hospA2 are hospital A's patients split in two (map-icu_map) and run as two sites: a simulation of two hospitals; hospB is the small hospital.

what_the_aggregator_saw.description: first 3 of 138 masked n*w values each site sent in that round. Integers mod 2**128, given as decimal STRINGS because they exceed JavaScript's safe integer range; *_fraction is value / 2**128 for display. On its own each value is uniform random; the masks cancel only in the 3-site sum.

max_abs_difference_scope: all 138 weights and the bias of the final model
deployment: sec-* containers on the LinuxONE VM, commit 2ba0e68, fedsepsis 0.2.0, 3 sites: hospA1 medical ICU, hospA2 surgical ICU, hospB small hospital
